comment: Cross-language golden vectors for the per-assignment group-team name derivation. Every writer and reader of this contract must produce these bytes for these inputs: the Go contract (GroupTeamHash / GroupTeamName in cli/shared/contract/contract.go, asserted by contract_test.go), the web (groupTeamHash / groupTeamName in web/src/util/teamSlug.ts, asserted by teamSlug.test.ts), and the Python collector (group_team_hash in collect_scores.py, asserted by skeleton_tests). `hash` is the first 16 hex chars of SHA-256 over `<lowercased classroom>\u0000<lowercased assignment>`; the separator byte prevents ("ab","c") and ("a","bc") colliding, and lowercasing mirrors the repo-name formula so a mixed-case input can't split one assignment's teams into two namespaces. `team_1` is the full team NAME for counter 1 — the name is slug-safe by construction (lowercase hex + hyphens), so GitHub's name-to-slug generation is the identity function and name == slug.
